Email Sticky Notes

Attach private, color-coded, timestamped sticky notes, interactive checklists, priority badges, and reminders directly to emails in Gmail (Google Workspace Add-on & Chrome Extension) and Microsoft Outlook (Web, Windows, and Classic).

⬇️ 1. Download Add-in Manifest (manifest.xml) 🚀 2. Open Outlook Add-in Installer 🔍 Try Interactive Web Preview

How Anyone Can Install in 30 Seconds:

  1. Click Download Add-in Manifest (manifest.xml) above to save the configuration file to your computer.
  2. Click Open Outlook Add-in Installer (or inside Outlook go to Apps → Manage Add-ins → My add-ins).
  3. Under Custom Addins, click Add a custom add-in → Add from file... and select the downloaded email-sticky-notes-manifest.xml file.
  4. Open any email in Outlook, click Email Notes in the ribbon, and pin the pane!
